name: 52-week high breakout
idea: On the Daily chart: a signal on the first close beyond the highest high of the previous weeks you set (one year by default), or below the lowest low for the mirror side; the idea is wrong beyond the latest opposite swing.

params.label: Weeks looked back
params.help: The close must go beyond the highest high (or lowest low) of this many previous calendar weeks; 52 weeks is one year.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond that high the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Volume expansion
params.help: The breakout bar's volume must be at least this many times the average (0 means no volume condition; indices have no volume).

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The latest confirmed swing on the other side, or the far end of the breakout bar.
choice_labels: The far end of the breakout bar

params.label: Swing size
params.help: Which swings count for the invalidation and the exit: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger swings need more history.

params.label: The idea has ended
params.help: No exit signal from this template, or a close beyond the latest confirmed opposite swing.
choice_labels: A close beyond the opposite swing
